name: Fear of Sleep Paralysis
oracle_text:
Flying
Eerie — Whenever this creature or another enchantment you control enters and whenever you fully unlock a Room, tap up to one target creature and put a stun counter on it.
Stun counters can't be removed from permanents your opponents control. (They won't untap if they have stun counters.)
blocked_sentences: Eerie — Whenever this creature or another enchantment you control enters and whenever you fully unlock a Room, tap up to one target creature and put a stun counter on it.
Stun counters can't be removed from permanents your opponents control. (They won't untap if they have stun counters.)

needs.what: a trigger event 'whenever you fully unlock a Room' (Eerie), firing when a Room you control has both of its doors unlocked, whether the second door is unlocked by the special action or the Room is otherwise made fully unlocked; it depends on the Room engine support filed as `rooms`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has no unlock event and the engine has no Room permanents; self_enters + permanent_enters (enchantment, exclude_self) cover the enters half of Eerie as Doomwake Giant does, and `tap` + `add_counters` (counter: stun) on an up-to-one creature target cover the effect, but dropping the Room clause would make the card strictly narrower

needs.what: a static that stops stun counters being removed from permanents matching `affects` (here controller: opponent) by any means: the 122.1d untap replacement in `primitives.untap_or_stun` must no longer spend the counter (so the permanent stays tapped and keeps it), and remove_counters / move_counters / costs that remove stun counters from such permanents must remove none
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cant_have_counters` stops counters being put on, not removed; `skip_untap_step` / `untap_limit` change untapping wholesale rather than keeping the stun counter in place, and no static_effects entry intercepts counter removal
